_meta.description: The intentionally-open gate markers an unchecked acceptance-criterion box may carry, with meaning, precedent and closure rule. Consolidated from the /work Step 4b marker table and the Step 5 closure-by-marker rules (#2765, target identified in #2605). Consumed by both steps; nonstop-audit.js pins the same GATE tokens as GATE_PHASES.

markers.meaning: Closure deferred to a QA sub-issue.
markers.closure: The box stays open until its QA sub-issue closes (see .claude/scripts/shared/lib/qa-config.json closurePath); the parent reaches done only once the box is checked.

markers.meaning: The condition resolves after the issue reaches in_review — a human read-and-approve step.
markers.closure: Checked by the user during review; these boxes are precisely what the STOP boundary hands off, so done implies the user has satisfied them.
Checked when the owning release step runs; if one is still open at /done, say so rather than checking it.

rule: A gate box is checked when its named resolving event has occurred, never because the issue is closing (#2726). A bare → GATE:, an unrecognised token, or the word gate in ordinary AC prose is unfinished work, not a marker.
